lines.trans: Why does everyone beat me in this house?
And who is that singing?
Young people these days, they don't know anything! That's Leshchenko! A star!
He courted me after a concert once. He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!
And nobody asked you to marry him and move to Paris?
And instead I married my Grisha. Now they won't even bury me next to him!
That's because everything there takes a bribe.
What sort of bribes could there be? A hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
And is that a small sum to you? My pension is twelve thousand!
You ate up my caviar! And you drank a poor old woman's cognac!
I told you I'll pay it all back! What a greedy woman you are.
You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!
Better into my coffin than to you! You're a bad man, Arkady.
Klavdia Viktorovna, there's a child here, we're having breakfast. And the television, by the way, is ours!
Oh, look, they're showing Samson on television! Several million views already!

examples.text: Почему меня все бьют в этом доме?
examples.trans: Why does everyone beat me in this house?
I grew up in a communal flat.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

выпить.gloss: to drink, to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink
meanings.note: often used without an object for drinking alcohol

examples.trans: Oh, I've had a bit to drink now.

That is better than twelve years.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: There's a child here, we're having breakfast.

meanings.en: into marriage (of a woman marrying a man)

meanings.note: звать на помощь = to call for help
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

examples.trans: There are bright stars in the sky.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar
